name: Seeed Fusion
notes: FR-4 Fusion standard service. Trace/space options for 1 oz: 6/6 mil (standard), 5/5 and 4/4 mil (extra cost; cost tiers per third-party KiCad forum thread, Seeed's spec only lists the options). 0.1 mm solder mask dam is a separate order option (>=0.10 mm green, >=0.13 mm other colours). 2 oz: 10/10 mil, 3 oz: 15/15 mil. 4-layer inner traces >= 6 mil. Advanced PCB service (HDI etc.) not covered.

value_notes.via_drill: Spec: 'Via Holes 0.2 - 0.5 mm'. Seeed does not say whether 0.2 mm costs extra.
value_notes.via_diameter: Not published directly; = 0.2 mm drill + 2 x 0.1 mm via annular ring.
value_notes.npth_drill: 'Drill Hole Diameter (NPTH) 0.2 - 6.3 mm (larger sizes will be milled)'.
value_notes.max_drill: NPTH up to 6.3 mm; PTH up to 5.8 mm.
value_notes.hole_to_hole: Spec lists 'Minimum spacing' 0.3 mm (12 mil) for vias and 0.45 mm (18 mil) for PTH without saying edge-to-edge or centre-to-centre; the PTH value is used (conservative).
value_notes.hole_to_copper: 'PTH to trace >= 12 mil'. Inner layers: 'Minimum distance between inner trace and plated holes >= 0.2 mm'.
value_notes.mask_bridge: Without the 0.1 mm dam option: >= 0.32 mm green, >= 0.35 mm other colours.
value_notes.track_width: 'For 1 oz: 4/4 mil, 5/5 mil, 6/6 mil' - 6/6 mil is the no-surcharge option.
